jobs.prompt: Bump the version from 1.167.7 to 1.167.8. In package.json and package-lock.json (both places in the lock: the top version and packages[""].version) change 1.167.7 to 1.167.8. In README.md change every 1.167.7 pin (kickoff text, tag name) to 1.167.8. In these tests replace the 1.167.7 pin with 1.167.8 where it is the current-version pin (assertions, test titles, the pin map in the AH release test): tests/t101-release.test.mjs, tests/field-lesson-t80-cli.test.mjs, tests/field-lessons-batch-x.test.mjs, tests/field-lessons-batch-ab-release.test.mjs, tests/field-lessons-batch-ag-release.test.mjs, tests/field-lessons-batch-ah-release.test.mjs. In CHANGELOG.md add a NEW top entry ## 1.167.8 above the 1.167.7 entry (keep it unchanged) with the lead-in line: The local lane takes work, and tickets no longer park on files they create. And these bullets, each starting with a bold lead word: Local lane: a key-less probe that gets 401 or 403 means the endpoint is up and wants a key, so dev2 over a tunnel is routed instead of being marked unreachable; swarm doctor local --probe-local --verify-key checks the Keychain key without printing it. Splitter: a path a ticket owns (files, tests of any ticket type, contracts it writes, new sources) is never reported as missing; a read owned by another ticket adds the dependency instead of parking; acceptance globs and foreign files add dependencies. Do not touch any other file.
